description: Velocity Local Services: an app for running LLMs locally on Windows and Linux. Load any GGUF model and chat with web search, tools and schematics, let it use your computer by voice, and serve it to opencode, Hermes or any app through an OpenAI-compatible API and MCP. Context up to 32M tokens. No cloud.
